request.user_text:
SCENE HEADING: EXT MARKET STREET — DAY

ACTION / DESCRIPTION:
EXT. MARKET STREET — DAY #48#

Inspector Dalvi pushes through a dense crowd of fruit vendors and shoppers.
Sirens wail in the distance.

DALVI
Block the southern exit! Nobody leaves this bazaar!

Sixty background extras scatter in panic as vegetable crates collapse.

output.scene_summary: Inspector Dalvi orders a lockdown of a crowded bazaar, causing sixty panicked shoppers and vendors to scatter as vegetable crates collapse.

elements.name: Inspector Dalvi
elements.description: Speaking actor who pushes through the crowd and orders the southern exit blocked.

elements.name: Market Shoppers and Vendors
elements.description: Sixty background extras who populate the bazaar and scatter in panic.
elements.safety_notes: Crowd movement must be carefully choreographed to prevent trampling.

elements.name: Crowd Panic Choreography
elements.description: Choreographed movement of sixty extras running and scattering through a tight market space.
elements.safety_notes: Stunt coordinators must map out clear running lanes to avoid collisions.

elements.name: Collapsing Vegetable Crates
elements.description: Specially prepared lightweight wooden or foam crates designed to collapse safely on cue.
elements.safety_notes: Must be free of sharp edges, splinters, or heavy nails.

elements.name: Market Produce
elements.description: Fruits and vegetables to stock the vendor stalls and scatter on the ground.
elements.safety_notes: Crushed real fruit can create severe slip hazards; consider rubber/fake produce for high-traffic footpaths.

elements.name: Distant Sirens
elements.description: Sound of police sirens wailing in the distance.

elements.name: Inspector Dalvi's Uniform/Suit
elements.description: Professional attire or police uniform for Inspector Dalvi.

elements.name: Bazaar Market Stalls
elements.description: Set dressing for a dense market street, including tables, canopies, and signs.
elements.safety_notes: All structures must be securely anchored to withstand the crowd rush.

elements.name: Slip and Trip Hazard Control
elements.description: Dedicated crew members to sweep and dry the pavement between takes to remove crushed produce.
elements.safety_notes: Essential to prevent actors and extras from slipping during fast-paced movement.

stop_conditions: Any actual slip or fall during the crowd panic sequence.
Accumulation of crushed fruit on the ground creating an unmanaged slip hazard.
Failure of breakaway crates to collapse safely, leaving exposed sharp materials.
continuity_notes: Dalvi's physical state (sweat, dirt, disheveled clothing) must match subsequent pursuit scenes.
The distribution of scattered fruit and collapsed crates must be reset to match continuity across multiple takes and camera angles.
